in_marathi.name: Parineeta
in_marathi.long_meaning: Parineeta हे एक हिंदू नाव आहे जे भारतीय संस्कृतीत खोल आध्यात्मिक महत्त्व ठेवते। The name Parineeta is derived from the Sanskrit word pari meaning 'near' and netra meaning 'eyes' or 'lotus-feet'. In Hindu mythology, lotus-feet are considered sacred as they represent the divine presence. The name Parineeta signifies one who is dear to all and holds a special place in the hearts of loved ones.
